hebrew:
וַיְהִי בִּנְסעַ הָאָרן וַיּאמֶר משֶׁה.

קוּמָה ה' וְיָפֻצוּ איְבֶיךָ. וְיָנֻסוּ מְשנְאֶיךָ מִפָּנֶיךָ:

כִּי מִצִּיּון תֵּצֵא תורָה. וּדְבַר ה' מִירוּשָׁלָיִם:

בָּרוּךְ שֶׁנָּתַן תּורָה לְעַמּו יִשרָאֵל בִּקְדֻשָּׁתו:
translation:
It happened upon the journeying of the Ark, Moses said:

“Rise, Almighty,” and Your enemies were dispersed, and Your foes were put to flight from before You.

For out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of the Lord from Jerusalem.

Blessed is the one who gave Torah to the people of Israel in holiness.
